item.title: Korail slum fire leaves thousands homeless
item.description: Dhaka – Firefighters have extinguished a massive blaze that destroyed more than 1,500 shanties in one of Dhaka’s largest slums, officials said Wednesday. It took 19 fire engines over 16 hours to fully contain the fire, which erupted Tuesday evening in the Korail slum of the Mohakhali neighbourhood. item.title: Districts get new police chiefs ahead of national polls
item.description: Dhaka – The interim administration has issued a notification on Wednesday appointing new chiefs of police in all 64 district ahead of the national election planned for voting in February next year. item.title: Hasina and family jailed over land graft charges
item.description: Dhaka – Former Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina and her son and daughter were sentenced to jail for their alleged involvement in graft related to allocation of land in a government project, court officials said on Thursday. item.title: Public outcry leads to arrest in Pabna puppy drowning case
item.description: Dhaka – Police arrested a woman on Wednesday accused of killing eight puppies in Ishwardi of the northern Bangladeshi district of Pabna, following a public outcry over the deaths nearly a week ago. item.title: Police baton-charge Dhaka protests over port deals
item.description: Dhaka – Several people were injured after police used batons to disperse a protest in Dhaka on Thursday. item.title: Khaleda Zia set for medical evacuation to UK
item.description: Dhaka – Ailing former Bangladeshi prime minister Khaleda Zia may be flown to the United Kingdom for advanced medical care as her condition remains largely unchanged at a Dhaka hospital. item.title: Bangladesh to announce election, referendum schedule Thursday
item.description: Dhaka – The Election Commission is expected to announce the schedule for the upcoming parliamentary election on Thursday. Alongside the 13th parliamentary election, the commission will also announce the schedule for the country’s third constitutional referendum, with both polls to be held on the same day. item.title: Bangladesh sees surge in expatriate voter registration
item.description: Dhaka – For the first time, over 300,000 Bangladeshi expatriates have registered to vote through postal ballot service in the upcoming parliamentary election, the Election Commission (EC) announced on Thursday. item.description: Dhaka – Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) AMM Nasir Uddin on Thursday announced that the next parliamentary election would be held on February 12 (Thursday) next year.
